entities.summary: Paşalimanı Island, formerly Halone, is an island in the southern Sea of Marmara in Turkey. The island is the fifth largest island of Turkey and administratively belongs to the Erdek town of Balikesir Province in northwestern Turkey. The island has five small villages and has 962 population in total. Paşalimanı Island is also part of the Marmara Archipelago along with three other islands Marmara, Avşa and Ekinlik.
